title: AW27 Women's Material Innovations
summary: Material innovations for AW27 women: thermoregulating and lighter wools, hidden membranes, bio-based leather alternatives, chrome-free leathers.
research_period: Pitti Filati, June 2026; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica, September 2026; forecaster reports to November 2026

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Pre-runway forecast. The AW27 shows run from January to March 2027. This report is built from the 2026 yarn, fabric and leather fairs (Pitti Filati in June; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica in September), published forecaster views and the SS27 runways. Forecut will update it after the shows.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- Separable double-faced woollens return in more varied weights; ultrafine yarns and tight knits make wool lighter and softer, with thermal comfort without synthetics<sup>[1]</sup>
- Citywear suitings hide waterproof, breathable or windproof membranes, three-layer constructions and bi-stretch, so a jacket looks like a classic suit while performing like technical wear<sup>[1]</sup>
- Leather alternatives (bio-based polymers, hemp, wool, brushed alpaca) remain niche, with a "considerable gap" between market weight and communication<sup>[1]</sup>
- TFL names authenticity, "soft volumes and clean, refined colours" and nubuck as a key leather; vegetable-tanned and chrome-free leathers are growing strongly<sup>[2]</sup>
- Woolmark presented merino wool as "the technical fibre" for AW27 sourcing at Pitti Filati<sup>[3]</sup>

sections.heading: Readiness
sections.body:
| Material | Readiness (Forecut assessment) |
|---|---|
| Lighter, softer wools | Ready |
| Membrane suiting | Ready |
| Chrome-free and vegetable-tanned leather | Ready; growing |
| Bio-based leather alternatives | Niche; verify claims |

design_implications: - Prefer proven fibres over unproven alternatives.
commercial_implications: - Do not overclaim; EU greenwashing rules apply.
